name: CR-Int-14-substitution-6.c
questiontext:
Using the method of integration by substitution, find the following integral:\[ \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}. \]

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
We need to calculate \[\int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}\] by means of the substitution \(u={{CT:2}}\) <hint>calc_int_methods_substitution</hint>.

So, if \(u = {{CT:2}}\) then \(d{{CT:3}} = {{CT:4}} d{{CT:1}}\), so, \(d{{CT:1}} = d{{CT:3}}/{{CT:4}}\).

Hence,

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
\int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int {{CT:5}} \frac{d{{CT:3}}}{{CT:4}} \\&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:3}} \\&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:7}} \int {{CT:8}} d{{CT:3}} \\&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:7}}{{CT:9}} \\&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:10}}
 \end{array}\]
